newsitem.title: USA: Detroit Ed says to restart 1,116 MW nuke.
newsitem.headline: Detroit Ed says to restart 1,116 MW nuke.

text.p: Detroit Edison Co said Thursday it will restart its 1,116 megawatt (MW) Fermi 2 nuclear generating station later today after shutting the plant Tuesday to repair a drywell vacuum breaker.
"It's supposed to restart this afternoon," a company spokesman said. "The vacuum breaker situation has been resolved."
The Newport, Michigan, nuclear facility was manually shut Tuesday to correct the breaker that failed to close during restart.
Fermi 2 was taken off line September 27 for refueling and maintenance and in the process of startup earlier this week.
DTE Energy Corp is the parent of Detroit Edison Co.
